fire.prompt: Close burning wood and building fire, continuous crackling flames and low roaring heat, no music, no speech, seamless loop for a strategy game.

hose.prompt: High pressure firefighter water hose spraying a continuous jet of water, pump motor rumble, splashing water, no speech or music, seamless loop.

regenerations: Exactly one regeneration each for fire and hose (the first takes were 1.04 s because loop=false and no duration were set on the node). The ready voice line was not regenerated.

processing.loops: Raw 9.0 s / 5.0 s takes were made seamless with an equal-power (sine/cosine) cross-fade of the final 1.0 s (fire) / 0.6 s (hose) into the first 1.0 s / 0.6 s, so the files are 1.0 s / 0.6 s shorter (8.0 s / 4.4 s) and wrap without any start/end fades. Verified: the wrap-point sample step is below the 99th percentile of normal sample steps (no click). MP3 encoder padding is 0.046 s (LAME gapless header present).
processing.loudness: Linear gain (no dynamic processing except a -3 dBFS peak limiter on the crackling fire loop) to match the existing pack: voice line about -23 LUFS like the ack* lines, loops about -22 to -25 LUFS as quiet positional beds.
processing.ready_trim: Trailing silence trimmed to 2.35 s with a 0.15 s fade-out.
